correctness.rationale: For complex V dimension n≥2 and d≥3, τ(v_d(PV)) consists of [ℓ^(d−1)m]. A diagonal one-parameter subgroup with generator weights 1,(d+1),...,(d+1)^(n−1) has distinct weights on all degree-d monomials. A fixed monomial belongs to τ iff its exponent vector has some entry≥d−1; unique factorization leaves exactly n pure powers and n(n−1) ordered mixed x_i^(d−1)x_j, distinct for d≥3, for a total n². Torus Euler localization on the projective tangential variety proves χ_top=n². Independent exhaustive exponent vector enumeration for (n,d)=(2,3),(3,3),(4,5),(5,4) returned 4,9,16,25 fixed monomials, and quadratic d=2 has the separate binomial(n+1,2) count. A further geometric cross-check is the continuous bijective proper map P(V)×P(V)→τ(X) for d≥3, hence a homeomorphism; its χ is n·n. No smoothness is assumed.

The formula is simple, and the existing parameterization yields another short proof, limiting its depth; nevertheless it gives a motivated exact invariant rather than an arbitrary finite slice.
